## Hosted test-build defect, not a runtime-test failure

PR #46 head `412f497accab0a23e79a9c568dcd461321e2cab7` currently fails all four required test/release jobs in [run 40806233773](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40806233773). Head and latest check conclusions were rechecked on 2026-10-29 at 02:48 UTC; the failures are not superseded.

Actions checked out synthetic merge `8a4fba00e1e3bc67b3f00659e09a85b69e83e3a9` (candidate `412f497a` into base `0d5605154dd923c46ec907fc8f59f579ca3bfff7`).

### Evidence / reproduction

With the committed dependency lock, CI runs `npm run build:test` (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) as part of coverage/release checks. All four decoded logs report:

```
test/sync.test.ts(95,34): error TS2345:
Argument of type 'GetItemProjection' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ItemMetadata'.
Types of property 'title' are incompatible.
Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
```

- [Node 22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40806233773/job/123225729503)
- [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40806233773/job/123225729179)
- [npm release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40806233773/job/123225729688)
- [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40806233773/job/123225729695)

The [exact source assertion](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/412f497accab0a23e79a9c568dcd461321e2cab7/test/sync.test.ts#L89-L101) passes `(await f.pm.get(item.id)).item` to `localValues`. The returned projection allows an absent title, while the callee requires ItemMetadata.

Expected: the new ownership-refusal regression compiles against the pinned SDK and reaches its real source/built assertions. Actual: test compilation exits 1 before the runtime coverage suite. Production typecheck, build, committed-dist parity and docstring steps separately passed in the Node26 job.

### Impact and limits

The exact revision has no completed passing full test/release gate. This is not evidence that native claim handling fails at runtime, nor a recurrence of the historical functional/coverage failures in #60/#59. Those were superseded at earlier heads and remain distinct.

Independent bounded review used deterministic in-memory SDK doubles: five history-fence cases passed against source and committed dist separately. These do not certify native concurrency, provider behavior, crash recovery or the full suite. No package publication or production regression is claimed.

### Owner and acceptance

Canonical owner: [pm-ado-sdk-adoption at the tested head](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/412f497accab0a23e79a9c568dcd461321e2cab7/.agents/pm/chores/pm-ado-sdk-adoption.toon), with [pm-ado-sdk-history-fence](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/412f497accab0a23e79a9c568dcd461321e2cab7/.agents/pm/issues/pm-ado-sdk-history-fence.toon). Its accepted validation requires source/built refusal evidence and unchanged full gates.

- Obtain/narrow an appropriately complete typed item for the assertion; do not remove the native-claim regression or mask the mismatch with weakened test checking.
- Preserve the assertion that claiming changes no synchronized field, and both source/built SDK-refusal checks.
- Run test compilation, then Node22/26 and npm/Bun full gates at unchanged thresholds on the corrected immutable head.
- Record resulting evidence separately from earlier-head passes.

Deduplication checked all-status issues/PRs, current PR body, complete conversation/inline/reviews and canonical adoption record. None specifically captured this TS2345; old quota-only review messages were ignored.
